description:
Centralized online book reading platforms  such as Google Books, Wattpad, and Scribd charge about 40-50% extra margin for reading books on their websites. 

The original content of authors gets compromised at times due to the malicious attacks over these centralized book reading platforms and their repositories.
how_its_made: It was tough to setup IPFS and Web3Auth. It took most of our time. Designing a strategy was tough where we aimed to complete our project within deadline.
